name: BSP_NetworkClient_StopThreads
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void __thiscall f(client): under the critical section at client+0x14c it sets the quit flag DAT_00f8abe0 to 1, then polls Sleep(10) re-taking the lock until DAT_00f8abe1 and DAT_00f8abe2 are both zero, then CloseHandle(client+0x154) and CloseHandle(client+0x158). A stop-and-join of two workers with no timeout. Called at 00737fda only when DAT_00f8abdc is set.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_IsProfileChangePending
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*) returning bool, ret with no stack argument. Returns manager+2Ch != 0 && manager+3C0h != 3E5h, so the profile-changed report is suppressed while an asynchronous operation is still ERROR_IO_PENDING. Unlike its siblings at 00a3e3e0..00a3e440 it takes no clear argument and leaves the flag set. Callers 004db290 at 004db2d3 and 0067cfb0. No writer of manager+2Ch exists in segment 00a371c0-00a46930. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_TakeStorageRemoved
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*, bool clear), RET 4. Reads manager+2Fh into AL and stores 0 back when the argument is non-zero. One of a family at 00a3e3e0 (+2Dh), 00a3e400 (+2Eh), 00a3e420 (+2Fh) and 00a3e440 (+31h) sharing the same five-instruction shape. Sole caller 004db290 at 004db411 with clear = 1, so the flag is consumed whether or not the FE_xbox.xsm_storageremovedauto prompt is raised. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_TakeInviteAccepted
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*, bool clear), RET 4. Reads manager+31h into AL and stores 0 back when the argument is non-zero. manager+31h is set by the XN_LIVE_INVITE_ACCEPTED arm of 00a40110 at 00a4033c, alongside the XINVITE_INFO copy into manager+32h. Sole caller 004db290 at 004db4fc with clear = 1, reached only when game+5D4h >= 2, so an invite that arrives earlier in the boot sequence stays pending. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_GetAcceptedInviteInfo
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. Two instructions: lea eax,[ecx+32h]; ret. Returns the address of the 84-byte block 00a40110 fills from XInviteGetAcceptedInfo at 00a4034c. The REP MOVSD count of 15h dwords and the fields 004db290 reads identify it as XINVITE_INFO: +00h xuidInvitee, +08h xuidInviter, +10h dwTitleID (compared against 534307FAh at 004db574), +14h hostInfo.sessionID (compared at 004db54f), +1Ch hostInfo.hostAddress (passed to XNetXnAddrToPlatform at 004db58d), +40h keyExchangeKey, +50h fFromGameInvite (tested at 004db805). Currently tagged trivial_body. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_FindSlotForInvitee
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*) returning an int. Walks the local user slots, comparing the 8-byte key at manager+110h + 8*i against the first 8 bytes of the accepted invite (manager+32h, XINVITE_INFO.xuidInvitee) while manager+8Ch + 4*i is non-zero. The loop bound at 00a3e49d is 1, so the result is 0 or 1 and 1 means no slot matched. 004db290 compares it against 00a3eac0 twice, at 004db528 and 004db6da, to decide whether the invitee is the active local profile. 00a3e4b0 is the identical search against xuidInviter at info+08h. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_FindSlotForInviter
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. __fastcall(XenonSystemManager*) returning an int. Identical in shape to 00a3e470 but compares the slot key at manager+110h against manager+3Ah, that is XINVITE_INFO.xuidInviter at info+08h. Bound 1, so 0 or 1 with 1 meaning no local slot matched. Sole caller 004db290 at 004db61b: a result other than 1 means the invite came from a profile signed in on this console and raises FE_xbox.xsm_invitesameconsole. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_XenonSystemManager_GetActiveUserSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_session_polls, read-only analysis. Two instructions: mov eax,[ecx+11Ch]; ret. 00a40020, the sign-in reset path, sets manager+11Ch to 1 unless manager+3BDh is set, and the slot loops in 00a3e470 and 00a3e4b0 are bounded at 1, so 1 reads as no active slot. 004db290 compares this against 00a3e470 at 004db528 and 004db6da to decide whether the accepted invite is addressed to the active local profile. Currently tagged trivial_body. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.
